comments.headline: Missing required setback lines
comments.summary: Zoning district setback requirement lines are not shown, labeled, or dimensioned on the site plan, preventing verification of building setback compliance.

details.text: Required setback lines for front, rear, interior side, and street side are not shown, labeled, or dimensioned. While informal building dimensions are present (19.3', 25', 21.3', 29.6', 46.9', 26.1', 25.8', 33.3'), they are not identified as required setback lines with corresponding code citations or required distances.

runComments.comment: Required zoning district setback lines (front, rear, interior side, street side) per LDC § 25-2-492 are not shown, labeled, or dimensioned on the site plan. While informal distance dimensions appear from property lines to buildings (19.3', 25', 21.3', 29.6', 46.9', 26.1', 25.8', 33.3'), these are not identified as setback requirement lines with corresponding code citations or identification of required distances. Setback lines must be clearly drawn and labeled with both the required distance and the applicable code section.

comments.headline: Missing fence height and design details
comments.summary: Wooden privacy fences are shown on the landscape plan but lack required height dimensions and design specifications. Fence compliance cannot be verified against code requirements.
comments.attn: Height dimensions required to verify 6-foot maximum (or 7-foot where grade change ≥1 foot) per LDC § 25-2-899(D)/(E). Design details must confirm prohibited elements per LDC § 25-2-899(I) are not included.

details.text: Wooden privacy fences along Northern, Eastern, and Southern property boundaries (designated H-6 on plan) lack height dimensions or specifications. Code requires height compliance: 6-foot maximum per LDC § 25-2-899(D), or 7 feet where grade change ≥1 foot per LDC § 25-2-899(E).

runComments.comment: Wooden privacy fences are shown along Northern, Eastern, and Southern property boundaries (designated H-6 in plan legend), but no fence heights are dimensioned or specified anywhere on the plan. LDC § 25-2-899(D) establishes 6-foot maximum height; § 25-2-899(E) permits 7 feet where grade change µ1 foot occurs. Without height dimensions, compliance with applicable maximum standards cannot be verified.

details.text: Fence design details are not provided on the landscape plan. LDC § 25-2-899(I) (effective July 31, 2023) prohibits spiked pickets above top rail, vertical pickets with 2-9-inch spacing above top rail, razor wire, barbed wire (except airports), and fences creating entrapment/impalement risk. Knuckle selvage required for solid chain link.

runComments.comment: Fence design details required by LDC § 25-2-899(I) are not shown on the Landscape Plan. Submittal date May 20, 2025 is after the July 31, 2023 effective date for design restrictions. The code prohibits: spiked pickets above the top horizontal backer rail; vertical pickets with 2-to-9-inch spacing above the top rail; razor wire; barbed wire (except airports); fences creating entrapment/impalement risk; and requires knuckle selvage for solid chain link. The plan must specify fence design and materials demonstrating compliance with these restrictions.

comments.headline: Clarify compatibility standards applicability
comments.summary: Applicability of Article 10 compatibility standards cannot be determined from submitted documents. MF-2 zoning may exempt the site from new Article 10 requirements effective July 15, 2024, but regulatory transition provisions require City staff clarification.
comments.crossDep: Zoning staff must clarify which compatibility framework applies to MF-2 zoned sites post-July 2024 regulatory change.
comments.attn: Verify with City whether MF-2 sites are subject to Article 10 (applies only to MF-4 or less restrictive zoning) or whether alternative compatibility framework or transition provisions apply.

details.text: New Article 10 (effective July 15, 2024) applies only to MF-4 or less restrictive zoning (MF-5, MF-6, commercial, industrial). This site is zoned MF-2, which is more restrictive than MF-4. Previous Subchapter F was completely repealed July 15, 2024. Submitted May 20, 2025 (after framework change), applicability of any compatibility framework to MF-2 site requires regulatory clarification.

runComments.comment: Compatibility standards (Article 10) applicability cannot be definitively determined from submitted documents. Site is zoned MF-2 and is adjacent to an SF-3 parcel. New Article 10 (effective July 15, 2024) applies only to sites zoned MF-4 or less restrictive (MF-5, MF-6, commercial, industrial); MF-2 is more restrictive than MF-4 and therefore is not subject to new Article 10. Previous Subchapter F was completely repealed July 15, 2024. Since this plan was submitted May 20, 2025 (after framework change), applicability depends on whether regulatory transition provisions or alternative compatibility frameworks apply to MF-2 sites, which requires City staff clarification.
